name: SNMP switches
description: Asks managed switches over SNMP v1 / v2c (read-only) which device is plugged into which port: the MAC address table and LLDP. Netlens shows each device's switch and port and places the switches in the hierarchy. Works with switches that have the standard bridge MIB (TP-Link, Netgear, HP / Aruba, Cisco, Zyxel, MikroTik, Ubiquiti and others). Tested against simulated switches only.
author: Netlens
supports: Managed switches with SNMP v1/v2c and the BRIDGE-MIB or Q-BRIDGE-MIB (not yet tested on hardware)

releases.changelog: First release. Written from the standard MIBs and tested against simulated switches only: please test it on a real switch and report back (see the README).
